title: Changeset
description: Describes what was changed in an implementation and why, classified from a consumer's perspective. Supersedes changeset@1 — adds required consumer_impact and semver_impact, set once at authoring time rather than re-derived at release time. Produced by courier's changeset-analyzer, consumed by courier's release-summarizer and by sentinel.

summary.description: Description of what changed, from the consumer's perspective. Length and detail scale with semver_impact: one clause for patch/internal-only, one sentence for minor, full detail for major. Under 200 characters.

consumer_impact.description: Whether this change is observable to someone outside this repo. See shared/references/changesets.md for classification rules.

semver_impact.description: Version bump this change requires, per the Semver Decision Guide in shared/references/changesets.md. release-summarizer takes max(semver_impact) across a release's changesets rather than re-deriving it.

files_changed.description: Paths of files added, modified, or deleted

tests_added.description: Paths of test files added or modified

acceptance_criteria_met.description: IDs from spec@1.acceptance_criteria that this changeset satisfies

criteria_evidence.description: Per-criterion evidence trail: exactly where each acceptance_criteria_met ID is tested and implemented. When sourced from implementer's own build, test_line and implementation_line are exact. When reconstructed from a diff with no smith run behind it, file-level entries without line numbers are acceptable rather than fabricating precision that was never observed. A criterion may have more than one entry when it is proven in more than one place.

breaking_changes.description: Public API or behavior changes that break existing callers. Each entry states old behavior, new behavior, and what the caller does about it.

commits.description: Git SHAs of commits in this changeset

linked_requirement.description: ID of the requirement@1 this change ultimately traces back to. Propagated from spec@1.linked_requirement via plan@1.linked_requirement when available.
